decision_rationale: H2O is presented as a foundational framework, not an application wrapper. The full text describes a decoder that predicts omics expression and training on 1.3 million paired H&E-spatial patches across 25 organs, supporting both generative and foundation-model evidence.
evidence_snippet: "the H2O decoder predicts the omics expression"; "trained on a pan-tissue dataset of 1.3 million paired H&E-spatial patches across 25 organs and cancer types"; "a foundational framework"
